name: Latent Diffusion Models (LDM) for 3D
definition: A model that learns a prior distribution pϕ(x) in the latent space to enable expressive latent representations, typically trained in two stages for NeRF auto-decoders.
summary: Latent Diffusion Models for 3D perform diffusion in compressed latent space to efficiently generate voxel-based neural fields, decoupling denoising from decoding to improve speed and quality over standard models.
